analysis:
The only change in this PR is in docs/developer/test.md, near head lines 1049-1050. It updates the SDK 27 release qualification text to SDK 27.2, Swift 6.4.2 and Xcode 27.2, and adds a link to the `release` toolchain in build.md. The supplied units show head lines 1-927 of the file and do not include the changed region, but the patch excerpt is complete and shows the change is documentation text only.

No code, key handling, attestation, authorization, cache encryption, App Attest, fan helper, add-on hold socket or sandbox installer behavior changes. No threat-model assumption in T-041, TB-011, TB-012 or TB-013 is affected. The surrounding test documentation describes isolated test fixtures, synthetic credentials and ephemeral cache roots, and it repeats the warning not to use production cache roots or keys. Its test environment variables (DARKBLOOM_SSD_TEST_TMPDIR, the prefix-cache test roots) only configure test fixtures. They do not alter the production cache gate, TTL, disk budget, or lookup-tag derivation covered by T-041.

Open question for integration: the build.md#sdk-27-release-builds-and-caches anchor and the pinned toolchain contents are outside the supplied evidence and were not verified. This is a documentation cross-reference only and has no security impact on its own.
